 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+python -m pip install pytest
+python -m pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file or test with `python -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py` or
+`python -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup`.
+
+No tests are checked in yet, so the above currently collects nothing — add
+`test_*.py` files next to the modules they cover.
